title: lygistum hirtellum
intro: Lygistum hirtellum, commonly known as Rough Bent, is a type of grass found in various parts of the world. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lygistum hirtellum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and protect the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
